question: Which of the following is the imitation of Taj Mahal of Agra?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bibi ka Maqbara**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Bibi ka Maqbara is the** imitation of Taj Mahal** of Agra.
 
• It is located in** Aurangabad(**Chhatrapati Sambhaji Nagar**), Maharashtra**.
 
• It is a mausoleum of** Rabla-ul-Daruni**, the** wife of** the Mughal Emperor **Aurangzeb**.
 
• It is believed that the mausoleum was** constructed by** **Prince Azam Shah** in memory of his mother during **1651 to 1661 A.D**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Humayun’s Tomb**

 
 
• Humayun’s Tomb was built in **1570 AD**.
 
• It is located in **Delhi.**
 
• It was the **first garden tomb** in the Indian subcontinent.
 
• It was included in **UNESCO World Heritage Site in 1993**.
 
 
 
• **Akbar's tomb**
 
 
• Akbar himself started the construction of this tomb.
 
• Later, its construction was completed by Akbar's son **Jahangir** in the year **1605-1613 AD**.
 
• It is located in **Sikandra, Uttar Pradesh**.
 
 
 
• **Daria Daulat Bagh**
 
 
• It was built by **Tipu Sultan** in **1784 AD.**
 
• It is located in **Srirangapatna, Karnataka**.
 
• The meaning of Daria Daulat Bagh is **Garden of the Sea of Wealth**.
 
• This garden is also known as **Tipu Sultan's Summer Palace**.
